title: import-error swallows AstroidBuildingError instead of AstroidImportError and friends
body:
<!--
  Hi there! Thank you for discovering and submitting an issue.

  Before you submit this, make sure that the issue doesn't already exist
  or if it is not closed.

  Is your issue fixed on the preview release?: pip install pylint astroid --pre -U

-->

### Steps to reproduce
1. Create files:

`repro.sh`
```bash
#!/bin/bash
virtualenv pylint19 -p python3.6
virtualenv pylint20 -p python3.6
virtualenv pylintpreview -p python3.6

source pylint19/bin/activate
pip install aws-encryption-sdk
pip install "pylint == 1.9.2"
deactivate

source pylint20/bin/activate
pip install aws-encryption-sdk
pip install "pylint == 2.0.0"
deactivate

source pylintpreview/bin/activate
pip install aws-encryption-sdk
pip install pylint astroid --pre -U
deactivate

echo "Testing with pylint 1.9.2"
source pylint19/bin/activate
pylint --version
pylint checkthis.py
deactivate

echo "Testing with pylint 2.0.0"
source pylint20/bin/activate
pylint --version
pylint checkthis.py
deactivate

echo "Testing with pylint preview release"
source pylintpreview/bin/activate
pylint --version
pylint checkthis.py
deactivate

```

`checkthis.py`
```python
"""Clear C0111"""

from aws_encryption_sdk.identifiers import Algorithm

Algorithm  # clear W0611 with pointless statement  pylint: disable=pointless-statement

```

2. Run `repro.sh`

### Current behavior

Starting in `2.0.0`, Pylint can no longer find modules in one of our libraries.  It does not include any C modules, but I tried the `unsafe-load-any-extention` and `extension-pkg-whitelist` options that commonly come up in searches for this behavior, with no effect.

### Expected behavior

Before `2.0.0` Pylint could find it.

### pylint --version output

See output in reproduction steps.
